status_effects.explanation: Charlus's open doubt about whether the narrator merits his effort locally positions the narrator as socially inferior and dispensable in the exchange.

appraisal_events.evidence: Je me demande si vous valez la peine que je me donne pour vous tout ce tracas... pour moi ce ne peut être que de l'ennui.
appraisal_events.explanation: Charlus directly questions whether the narrator is worth the trouble of his attention, staging him in the scene as a doubtful, dismissible interlocutor.
